admission: One client valid&&ready latches owner and addr13 into single transaction slot; a registered ROM request is forwarded next cycle. Admission is distinct from physical reader acceptance.
retirement: Only owner response valid&&ready releases transaction; reader return payload/valid routed only to owner. No OR ready, no broadcast return.
round_robin: Initial preference parameter client; after each admitted request preference switches to other owner. Sole requester wins regardless of preference. At most one other admitted request can bypass a continuously pending client, conditional on eventual physical ready/return and owner-ready.
cancel: No arbiter cancel port. Existing LUT service drains logical ROM transaction accepted by arbiter, including queued-before-physical-read. Arbiter never clears owner on cancellation.
reset: Common asynchronous assert across reader/arbiter/prefetch/LUT; arbiter local two-stage synchronous release, earliest third rising edge client admission
fault: Sticky global fault on reader fault or illegal FSM; owner not falsely retired. Original prefetch has no ROM fault input: expose global fault and require common reset; do not fabricate a successful response.
existing_prefetch_scope: Boot-time down2.dw.conv16 and down2.pw.conv16to24 parameters plus1024 SiLU; no runtime layer input, restart only common reset, no ROM fault input, not67 layers
verification: true down2 parameters and SiLU versus frozen manifest
LUT cancel before admission and after admission late return
scope: New directory only; one correct G10 reader, no frozen source/interface/II/numeric/reset changes, no full7168 re-audit, training/production/TD/bitstream/board/Flash/commit/push
